Raster-internal nodata/zero semantics and independent trail/distractor truth remain unresolved. The unchanged A checkpoint was re-scored on exact VAL membership with fixed raster-bounds masks. All five index hashes match. At 0.90 the legacy F1 is 0.3428 and coverage-aware F1 is 0.3537 for the same predictions; the large Corner Canyon change is due to removing 9,166 uncovered positive targets from the metric. Independent trail/distractor truth remains absent, so this only supports a diagnostic data-integrity run, not promotion.
